defs.def: happy and cheerful 愉快的；高兴的

ex.s: "What a wonderful pudding.Merry Christmas everyone!" said Bob.
ex.t: ＂多棒的布丁啊。大家圣诞快乐！＂鲍勃说。

ex.s: Merry Christmas, Bob!" From that day on, Scrooge was changed.
ex.t: 圣诞快乐，鲍勃！＂从那天起，斯克鲁奇变了。

ex.s: (Adapted from My Lai 4 by Seymour Hersh) 8 hunS We were on the frontier and on Christmas morning we stuck up a board displaying "A Merry Christmas" on it.
ex.t: 改编自西摩·赫什的《美莱村4号》：我们在边境前线，圣诞节的早晨，我们竖起了一块写着"圣诞快乐"的牌子。

ex.s: They had a kind and merry nursemaid, and a dog who was called James, and who was their very own.
ex.t: 他们有一个和蔼快乐的保姆，还有一只叫詹姆斯的狗，那是他们自己的狗。

ex.s: Luckily, I arrived just in time-the show was about to begin as I took my place in the merry crowd.
ex.t: 幸运的是，我到的刚刚好——当我在这欢乐的人群中找到位置时，演出正要开始。
